findings.title: Ported total goes up by two though only one game was added.
findings.body: The file changes by only +2 −1 lines: this counter and one new Burnout Paradise Remastered entry. So the list grows from 102 games to 103, not 104. The ported count (44) is right, but the total is now overstated by one. Fix: `**44 / 103 ported**`.

held.title: Every vertex shader is paired with the same pixel shader, c1a608e6add64c26.
held.body: All 184 vertex keys in this table map to one pixel shader. That is every vertex shader in `shader_map.tsv`: 67 from main and 117 from SHADERS.BNDL. The pixel shader is `ps_other.bin` 104, from a single bundle entry. Real BNSH variations would not all share one pixel shader, so this looks like a pairing bug in shader_split.py for this game's bnd2 or main-embedded shaders. If the host uses these pairs to link vertex outputs to pixel inputs, or to prewarm pipelines, the other 120 pixel shaders would be matched against the wrong stage. I couldn't see how the table is read. Please check the pairing logic for this game, or drop the table until the pairs are real.
